actions.label: Initial keyboard focus
actions.expected: Keyboard traversal begins from the application's actual initial active element.

actions.label: Reach the Library search
actions.expected: The target is reached from the actual current focus using keyboard traversal only.

actions.label: Select the Library query
actions.expected: The focused Library search owns the select-all shortcut, not the canvas graph.

actions.label: Filter Library for Prompt
actions.expected: The Library narrows using text typed through its keyboard-reached search field.
actions.actual: Typed 6 characters through the active keyboard target.

actions.label: Add Prompt from the Library
actions.expected: The target is reached from the actual current focus using keyboard traversal only.
actions.actual: Reached Add Prompt with 1 Tab key event.

actions.label: Add Prompt from the Library
actions.expected: Enter creates the canonical node through the ordinary Library command.

actions.label: Reach the authoring canvas
actions.expected: The target is reached from the actual current focus using keyboard traversal only.
actions.actual: Reached Authoring canvas with 15 Tab key events.

actions.label: Open canvas quick add
actions.expected: N opens the searchable node palette while the canvas owns focus.

actions.label: Filter quick add for Note
actions.expected: Quick add filters with text typed into its product-owned autofocus field.
actions.actual: Typed 4 characters through the active keyboard target.

actions.label: Insert Note from quick add
actions.expected: Enter inserts the active matching canonical node and returns focus to the canvas.
